clips.title: Hamstring stretch (hook-lying)

stations.text: Start lying on your back with your knees bent.
stations.label: To start

stations.text: Bring one leg up towards you and hold on to it behind the knee.
stations.label: The movement

stations.text: Stretch the leg up as straight as you can.

branch.text: Try and keep the pelvis level and both hips down on the floor at all times.

stations.text: To create a neuroglide, point and flex the foot as you hold the stretch.
Hold the stretch for about 60 seconds.
stations.label: The hold

stations.text: To help keep the knee straight, you may hold above the knee if you can reach.
stations.label: The movement

stations.text: Bend the knee and bring it down to finish.
stations.label: To finish

clips.prose: Start lying on your back with your knees bent. Bring one leg up towards you and hold on to it behind the knee. Stretch the leg up as straight as you can. Try and keep the pelvis level and both hips down on the floor at all times. To create a neuroglide, point and flex the foot as you hold the stretch. Hold the stretch for about 60 seconds. To help keep the knee straight, you may hold above the knee if you can reach. Bend the knee and bring it down to finish.

clips.title: Shoulder abduction with Theraband (standing)

stations.text: Start by stepping on the Theraband on the side of the arm that you would like to work.

branch.text: There should be no pinching or pain at the shoulder throughout.

stations.label: To start

stations.text: The arm should be just slightly in front of the leg, but out to the side.
stations.label: The movement

stations.text: Keeping the elbow straight, stretch the arm up to at the most shoulder height and slowly reverse the motion back down.
The motion going downward should take as long as the motion going upward in order to keep control of the band all the time.

branch.text: Be sure to keep your body still while you're doing the motion.

clips.prose: Start by stepping on the Theraband on the side of the arm that you would like to work. The arm should be just slightly in front of the leg, but out to the side. Keeping the elbow straight, stretch the arm up to at the most shoulder height and slowly reverse the motion back down. The motion going downward should take as long as the motion going upward in order to keep control of the band all the time. Be sure to keep your body still while you're doing the motion. There should be no pinching or pain at the shoulder throughout.

clips.title: Standing quad stretch with foot on a chair

stations.text: Stand where you can hold on to the back of a chair or a counter and bring a chair or stool behind you.
stations.label: To start

stations.text: Bring one leg up onto the chair and then stand as tall as possible, squeezing the hips forward and the bottom tight.

branch.text: Try and keep both knees in line with each other as you stand in order to stretch the front of the thigh or the quad muscle.

stations.label: The movement

stations.text: Repeat this motion on the other side, bringing the leg up behind you, then standing tall and pulling the hips forward, the bottom in.
stations.label: Repeat

stations.text: Both legs should be even with each other.
stations.label: The movement

stations.text: In order to increase the stretch, squeeze the bottom more forward and stand up even taller through the lower back.
Hold for at least 30 seconds upwards to 2 minutes.
stations.label: The hold

clips.prose: Stand where you can hold on to the back of a chair or a counter and bring a chair or stool behind you. Bring one leg up onto the chair and then stand as tall as possible, squeezing the hips forward and the bottom tight. Try and keep both knees in line with each other as you stand in order to stretch the front of the thigh or the quad muscle. Repeat this motion on the other side, bringing the leg up behind you, then standing tall and pulling the hips forward, the bottom in. Both legs should be even with each other. In order to increase the stretch, squeeze the bottom more forward and stand up even taller through the lower back. Hold for at least 30 seconds upwards to 2 minutes.

clips.title: Tandem-stance balance

stations.text: Standing next to a wall or a counter that you can hold on to, place one foot directly in front of the other, toe touching the heel.

branch.text: Try and maintain your balance in this position without holding on.
If you need more challenge, you can try closing your eyes in this position and holding again.

stations.label: To start

stations.text: Try and hold for up to 30 seconds.

branch.text: When you have completed one side, switch your foot position, bringing the other heel to toe, and repeat the exercise here, starting with your eyes open, and if you need increased challenge, closing the eyes, trying to maintain your balance.

stations.label: The hold

clips.prose: Standing next to a wall or a counter that you can hold on to, place one foot directly in front of the other, toe touching the heel. Try and maintain your balance in this position without holding on. If you need more challenge, you can try closing your eyes in this position and holding again. Try and hold for up to 30 seconds. When you have completed one side, switch your foot position, bringing the other heel to toe, and repeat the exercise here, starting with your eyes open, and if you need increased challenge, closing the eyes, trying to maintain your balance.

clips.title: Neck isometrics (flexion)

stations.text: While seated, take two fingers and place them on the forehead.
stations.label: To start

stations.text: Lower the eyes and look downward as if trying to flex the head.
stations.label: The movement

stations.text: Prevent the motion with the finger.
Hold about three seconds.

clips.prose: While seated, take two fingers and place them on the forehead. Lower the eyes and look downward as if trying to flex the head. Prevent the motion with the finger. Hold about three seconds.

clips.title: Forearm stretch, wrist flexed

stations.text: In a seated or standing position, extend one arm out, press the palm of the hand back towards the forearm and hold that position for at least 30 seconds up towards 1 minute, trying to feel a stretch through the top of the forearm and hand.
stations.label: The hold

clips.prose: In a seated or standing position, extend one arm out, press the palm of the hand back towards the forearm and hold that position for at least 30 seconds up towards 1 minute, trying to feel a stretch through the top of the forearm and hand.
